title: Warming Lazy-Sunday Slovakian Chicken Thighs Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew originating from Slovakia, made with chicken thighs, soffritto base, and a variety of vegetables.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: chicken broth can be used in addition or instead

instructions: Heat oil in a large hot pot over medium heat.
Chop onion and saut�93 it until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add chopped carrots and potatoes, cooking for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add chicken thighs, mustard seeds, allspice, and black pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add chopped dill and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
